results.title: How to Build a COPPA-Compliant Kid's Learning App - Idea Usher
results.snippet: A learning app must offer a clean, distraction-free interface without advertisers collecting hidden data through third-party SDKs. Any analytics, gamification, or educational plugin integrated into the app must also comply with COPPA rules.

results.title: COPPA Compliance in 2025: A Practical Guide for Tech, EdTech, and Kids’ Apps
results.snippet: The COPPA Rule lists factors including subject matter, visual content, the use of animated characters or child-oriented activities/incentives, music or other audio content, age of models, language, advertising appearing on child-directed sites/services, and other reliable evidence about the audience. 16 C.F.R. § 312.2 (definition of “website or online service directed to children”)

results.title: COPPA compliance | Adjust Help Center
results.snippet: For users 13 and over, the app initializes the Adjust SDK normally. For users under 13, the app enables COPPA compliance mode in the Adjust SDK, which disables advertising ID collection and disables third party data sharing on Adjust's servers.
